tool_args.content:
Publication-quality line plot for EMNLP 2026 proceedings.

Layout: Single panel, approximately 6×4.5 inches, 300 DPI.

Data — main curve (seed 42, connected with smooth line, circle markers):
b=0.1 → PPL=17.657
b=0.2 → PPL=17.640
b=0.3 → PPL=17.640
b=0.5 → PPL=17.651
b=1.0 → PPL=17.692
b=1.5 → PPL=17.718
b=2.0 → PPL=17.741
b=3.0 → PPL=17.774
b=5.0 → PPL=17.818

Cross-seed markers at b=0.5 only:
seed 123: PPL=17.638 (filled triangle)
seed 456: PPL=17.650 (open triangle)

Reference lines and annotations:
- Uniform baseline: horizontal dashed line at PPL=17.694, color #90A4AE, label "Uniform (17.694)" on right
- Adaptive b*: prominent filled circle at approximately b=0.9, PPL≈17.674, color #4A90D9, with annotation arrow "Adaptive b* (17.674)"
- ESS-only b*: X marker at approximately b=3.5, PPL≈17.789, color #E8913A, with annotation "ESS-only (17.789)"
- Degradation zone: light red (#C75C5C) shaded region for b >= 2.0

Colors:
- Main curve and adaptive marker: steel blue #4A90D9
- ESS-only marker: warm amber #E8913A
- Degradation shading: muted coral #C75C5C, alpha=0.10
- Uniform line: blue-gray #90A4AE
- Text color: #333333

Style requirements:
- Serif font family (e.g., Times New Roman, Liberation Serif)
- Outward-facing tick marks
- No top or right spines
- Light dashed grid lines (#ECECEC)
- X-axis label: "Sharpening exponent b"
- Y-axis label: "Held-out PPL"
- X range: 0 to 5.5
- Y range: 17.62 to 17.85
- Premium academic style suitable for top-tier NLP venue

source /tmp/pb_venv/bin/activate && GOOGLE_API_KEY="[REDACTED]" paperbanana generate \
  --input /tmp/fig_intent.txt \
  --caption "Effect of sharpening exponent b on held-out PPL" \
  --vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro \
  --output /tmp/pb_reference_grid_b.png \
  --iterations 5 2>&1
